other_failure_modes.name: Predicting hard labels instead of probabilities for log loss
other_failure_modes.description: The evaluation metric for this task is log loss, which inherently requires the model to output predicted probabilities for each class. The agent predicts hard class labels instead, which will result in an invalid or extremely poor score, and fails to match the expected Kaggle submission format (one column per class).

summary: The agent successfully engineers a variety of logical features and handles spatial outliers. However, the solution suffers from critical target leakage by computing frequency encodings and fitting LabelEncoders on the concatenated train and test sets. Furthermore, the agent fails to implement a validation strategy and critically outputs hard class labels instead of probabilities, which will fail evaluation under the log loss metric.
